thread:
Maria Chen (Partner Ops): Heads-up — we're running a SEV drill with Nimbus (HW partner) tomorrow 11:00am PT. Need to confirm the joint war room channel, escalation contacts, and SLA fallback steps. Can folks ack who will join the bridge? :wave:

Sourav Das (Solutions Eng): I'll be on the bridge for partner routing and quick triage. Can we use #partner-nimbus-warroom as the shared Slack channel?

Aj Patel (SRE oncall): Ack. I'll own infra triage and paging. ops-bot can open a bridge, but we need a fallback plan: if the dedicated bridge or Slack step fails, fallback to the Zoom link and the pager flow.

Lina Gomez (CS): I'll handle customer comms and the external-facing status doc. Please drop the public status URL and the email template to the channel when it's created.

ops-bot: Bridge created: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/987654321 — meeting pinned in #partner-nimbus-warroom :white_check_mark:

Sourav Das (Solutions Eng): Thanks ops-bot. Draft checklist to post in the channel — please review:  
- Initial triage owner: Aj Patel (SRE)
- Partner liaison: Maria Chen (Partner Ops)
- Customer comms: Lina Gomez (CS)
- Escalate to eng-rca if >30m with no progress
- If hardware indicators (power/PCI errors) => escalate to partner on-call at 15m
- Canary fallback: route traffic to smaller model / different zone

Maria Chen (Partner Ops): Add partner contact details: Nimbus on-call email nimbus-oncall@partner.com and phone +1-555-1212. If partner doesn't acknowledge in 10m for hardware-level issues, page via phone.

Aj Patel (SRE oncall): Agreed. Adding a quick runbook snippet for starting the war room from CLI and paging: 
```
/ops create-warroom --name partner-nimbus --severity sev2 --bridge
/pager notify @oncall --policy infra-high
```
Use that to create the bridge and trigger the paging flow.

Sourav Das (Solutions Eng): Can we include automated triage posters (latency / error-rate graphs) so the bridge has context immediately? devbot can push snapshots into the thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: perf-snapshot job will post to channel every 5m during the drill: https://dashboards.redwood/partner-nimbus/perf

Lina Gomez (CS): If customer impact exceeds 1 hour we'll send the escalation email template v2. I'll upload the template to the channel (and pin).

Maria Chen (Partner Ops): OK — final check before we lock the drill: 11:00–11:30am PT tomorrow, runbook pinned to #partner-nimbus-warroom, bridge link pinned. Aj/Sourav/Lina please confirm availability. After the drill we'll capture gaps and update the partnership runbook. :thumbsup:

Aj Patel (SRE oncall): Confirmed. I'll trigger the bridge at 10:58 PT and simulate degraded GPU availability (io/pci errors) to validate partner escalation.

Sourav Das (Solutions Eng): Confirmed. I'll enable devbot snapshots and the canary reroute step.

Lina Gomez (CS): Confirmed. I'll prep and test the external status doc and email template.

Maria Chen (Partner Ops): Thanks team — action items noted: 1) Add partner fallback phone in runbook (Aj), 2) Ensure perf snapshots / devbot alerts are configured (Sourav), 3) Finalize external message template (Lina). I'll own the post-drill notes and partner follow-up. ops-bot, please pin the bridge link and runbook.

ops-bot: Pinned: runbook (https://docs.redwood/partnerships/nimbus-runbook) and bridge link.

Maria Chen (Partner Ops): Closing loop — see you all tomorrow. We'll keep this thread for post-drill gaps and the short postmortem. :memo:
